name: @red-cup-engineering/wheatstone
description: wheatstone — a generic terminal MUD client over @red-cup-engineering/arnold's diffed cell buffer. Named for Charles Wheatstone, telegraph pioneer. It speaks the telnet client side (IAC option negotiation; GMCP / MSDP / MXP handling; streaming COMPRESS2/MCCP2 input), renders a scrolling ANSI-colored world pane, a GMCP/MSDP-fed status line, an optional side panel (who/room/audit), and a command line (history, aliases, triggers, local slash-commands). The world/carrier seam is pluggable without embedding any game-specific transport or content. Where it surfaces world state, the law is calm by default with audit on demand.
